selection_rule: Meet development B complete-evidence rate, then minimize judgment input proxy; if infeasible, maximize complete-evidence rate first.
evaluation_policy: Freeze both policies before loading evaluation labels. Exclude previously evaluated question IDs. Evaluation is exploratory on a gold-inclusive reduced corpus.
preparation_policy: Reuse the existing query-independent Jev classification to order passages; generate new group descriptions from original text only. Record inherited preparation cost separately.
